explanation: The name means 'head of the year'. A ram's horn called a shofar is blown, and apples dipped in honey are eaten in hope of a sweet year ahead.

issues.note: The Mishnah lists four 'new years' (1 Nisan, 1 Elul, 1 Tishrei, 15 Shevat). Rosh Hashanah (1 Tishrei) is the one called the Jewish New Year, and none of the other options is any kind of new year, so the key is unique.
